decisions.reason: By 2022 the uncertainty around this sports-flooring extension should largely have resolved, and its weaker fit with the firm's trend-led residential flooring direction makes the remaining option value look lower than the resources tied up in it.

A mobile arena floor is a specialized and likely costlier option to carry, and with a broad product range and other development opportunities the firm would likely redeploy resources once this niche product has had time to prove itself.
Because this is another mobile arena-floor option in an overlapping niche, its incremental option value is low after three years while the firm has many alternative uses for capacity and attention.
This chevron parquet sits close to the core offer and directly matches the firm's style-oriented growth path, so it remains a relatively attractive option to keep on the market.

As a very narrow sports-surface finish tied to a niche application, it is unlikely to justify continued commitment once market feedback has had time to emerge and the firm can focus on stronger core products.

Although an accessory is cheaper to carry than a full system, this item depends on the sports-floor line and is less aligned with the firm's main interior-flooring trajectory, so dropping it is more likely than keeping it.
